title: Xid, ECC or row-remap counters are not collected: failing GPUs go unnoticed
evidence: DaemonSet/gpu-operator/nvidia-dcgm-exporter (4.1.1-4.0.4-ubuntu22.04): no XID_ERRORS, ECC_SBE, ECC_DBE, UNCORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS, ROW_REMAP_FAILURE; field set from ConfigMap/gpu-operator/custom-dcgm-metrics key dcgm-metrics.csv

fix.summary:
DaemonSet/gpu-operator/nvidia-dcgm-exporter reads ConfigMap/gpu-operator/custom-dcgm-metrics key dcgm-metrics.csv. Add these lines to it, then restart the exporter pods:
DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS, gauge, Value of the last XID error encountered.
DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_SBE_VOL_TOTAL, counter, Total number of single-bit volatile ECC errors.
DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_DBE_VOL_TOTAL, counter, Total number of double-bit volatile ECC errors.
DCGM_FI_DEV_UNCORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS, counter, Number of remapped rows for uncorrectable errors
DCGM_FI_DEV_ROW_REMAP_FAILURE, gauge, Whether remapping of rows has failed
forge never edits an exporter it did not install.

title: The DCGM exporter exports only coarse utilisation: profiling counters (SM, tensor, DRAM activity) are off
evidence: DaemonSet/gpu-operator/nvidia-dcgm-exporter (4.1.1-4.0.4-ubuntu22.04): no PROF_GR_ENGINE_ACTIVE, PROF_SM_ACTIVE, PROF_SM_OCCUPANCY, PROF_PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE, PROF_DRAM_ACTIVE; field set from ConfigMap/gpu-operator/custom-dcgm-metrics key dcgm-metrics.csv

fix.summary:
DaemonSet/gpu-operator/nvidia-dcgm-exporter reads ConfigMap/gpu-operator/custom-dcgm-metrics key dcgm-metrics.csv. Add these lines to it, then restart the exporter pods:
DCGM_FI_PROF_GR_ENGINE_ACTIVE, gauge, Ratio of time the graphics engine is active.
DCGM_FI_PROF_SM_ACTIVE, gauge, The ratio of cycles an SM has at least 1 warp assigned.
DCGM_FI_PROF_SM_OCCUPANCY, gauge, The ratio of number of warps resident on an SM.
DCGM_FI_PROF_PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE, gauge, Ratio of cycles the tensor (HMMA) pipe is active.
DCGM_FI_PROF_DRAM_ACTIVE, gauge, Ratio of cycles the device memory interface is active sending or receiving data.
forge never edits an exporter it did not install.

title: node-problem-detector has no GPU rule: Xid errors never mark a node unhealthy
evidence: DaemonSet/kube-system/node-problem-detector: monitors disk-monitor, docker-monitor, kernel-monitor (from ConfigMap/kube-system/node-problem-detector-custom-config key disk-monitor.json), none matches NVIDIA Xid / NVRM kernel lines

title: 2 nodes had idle, unrequested accelerators at snapshot time
evidence: pool gpupool: Node/aks-gpupool-12345678-vmss000000: 1 × nvidia.com/gpu allocatable, none requested
pool gpupool: Node/aks-gpupool-12345678-vmss000001: 1 × nvidia.com/gpu allocatable, none requested

fix.summary: One snapshot is not a trend. If these nodes stay unrequested, lower the pool's minimum size in its autoscaler (cluster autoscaler, Karpenter, the cloud's node pool) so it scales down.

title: The collector does not keep Kubernetes events: scheduling, pull and eviction history is lost

fix.summary: Add a k8s_events receiver (or k8sobjects with `objects: [{name: events, mode: watch}]`) to DaemonSet/datadog/datadog-agent in a logs pipeline; run it in one replica so events are not duplicated.

title: No continuous profiling on the accelerator nodes

fix.summary: Run one continuous eBPF profiler as a DaemonSet on the accelerator nodes: Parca agent, Grafana Alloy with pyroscope.ebpf, or the OpenTelemetry eBPF profiler (otel/opentelemetry-collector-ebpf-profiler). It shows where CPU time goes in data loaders and serving code with no code change.

title: Image volumes are unavailable: weights cannot be mounted from an OCI artifact without a sidecar
evidence: API server v1.31.3: the ImageVolume feature gate is on by default from Kubernetes 1.35

fix.summary: Upgrade to Kubernetes 1.35+ with containerd 2.1+ to mount weights as an image volume. Until then, KServe's modelcar sidecar or an init-container copy is the fallback.
